reports.title: plugins: enabled external plugins never activate on the one-shot CLI run path (hooks silently skipped, no error)
reports.summary: External plugins configured and enabled fail to activate during one-shot CLI execution, resulting in hooks being silently skipped. Direct calls to the plugin registry work as expected, but the `openminion run` CLI path bypasses plugin initialization. This prevents expected plugin hooks from executing without raising any warnings or errors.
reports.suggested_next_action: Investigate CLI runner initialization logic to ensure plugin registry configuration is properly loaded and activated before processing commands.

reports.title: self_improvement: max_applied_notes and min_token_overlap are accepted, persisted and never enforced
reports.summary: Two configuration settings in runtime.self_improvement (max_applied_notes and min_token_overlap) are parsed and persisted but never enforced by runtime consumers. Operators setting these values experience silent no-op behavior while a hardcoded context limit remains active. Enforcing these parameters in note ranking and context retrieval will resolve the inconsistency.
reports.suggested_next_action: Verify if a contributor PR is actively addressing this issue, and update context retrieval and ranking logic to enforce max_applied_notes and min_token_overlap.
